responsibility: This file implements GCC’s simple post-reload RTL cleanup pass. After reload has assigned hard registers, it performs a lightweight cselib-based common-subexpression and operand simplification sweep over hard-register uses, removes noop sets, combines reload-generated instruction patterns, and runs the move2add optimization that tracks constant and register-plus-offset values to turn chains of moves into additions when profitable. Its responsibility is inexpensive hard-register-oriented simplification after reload, not full global CSE or pre-reload combine.
